description.en: Scheutje -Dutch, diminutive of scheut-: an imprecise splash or dash of liquid, typically 1–2 tablespoons -15–30 ml-. Common in cooking and coffee — a scheutje of milk, wine, or oil. Rooted in schieten -"to shoot/spurt"-, it describes the pouring motion rather than a fixed measure, meant to be eyeballed, not measured.
